text: {"lessons":["The account has fallen from 104,325 to 91,489, so I should review whether my allocation and risk level still fit my goals rather than ignore a sustained decline.","A few monthly movements do not reveal whether a holding is fundamentally sound; I should avoid impulsive trades and assess my portfolio on a planned, periodic schedule.","Since I rarely monitor the account, I should keep the strategy simple, diversified, and appropriate for my age, while making deliberate adjustments when my review shows they are needed."]}
